definitions.explanation: Fertilizer mixed into the soil before planting seeds or transplanting seedlings. Provides essential nutrients for the early growth stage of plants.

examples.japanese: ⟦{植|う}え{付|つ}け→植え付け：21341_uetsuke⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{元肥|もとごえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。

{元肥|もとごえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{与|あた}えて→与える：01821_ataeru⟧おく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{苗|なえ}→苗：05489_nae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{育|そだ}ち→育ち：13927_sodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you apply enough base fertilizer, the seedlings will grow better.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家庭菜園|かていさいえん}→家庭菜園：07085_kateisaien⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{堆肥|たいひ}→堆肥：06471_taihi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{元肥|もとごえ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効果的|こうかてき}→効果的：04793_koukateki⟧だ。
examples.english: In home vegetable gardens, using compost as base fertilizer is effective.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧ (base, foundation) and {肥|こえ} (fertilizer). An essential term in gardening and agriculture. The {元肥|もとごえ} is applied once before planting, in contrast to ⟦{追肥|ついひ}→追肥：08232_tsuihi⟧ which is applied during the growing season.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {元肥|もとごえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to add base fertilizer
- {元肥|もとごえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{施|ほどこ}す→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧: to apply base fertilizer (formal)
- {元肥|もとごえ}{入|い}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧: soil with base fertilizer already mixed in

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{追肥|ついひ}→追肥：08232_tsuihi⟧: top-dressing fertilizer — fertilizer applied after planting during the growth period
- ⟦{堆肥|たいひ}→堆肥：06471_taihi⟧: compost — organic matter used as fertilizer
- ⟦{液肥|えきひ}→液肥：26357_ekihi⟧: liquid fertilizer — fertilizer in liquid form
